items.synopsis:
One day, I woke up as a noble inside the game I used to play. Unfortunately, the game ends in an apocalypse. With ten years left, I track down the future villains while they’re still kids and decide to raise them myself, hoping that a better childhood could stop them from destroying the world. Now, with criminals dropping like flies, the kingdom thinks I’m the terrifying mastermind pulling all the strings. What on earth is happening? I just wanted to enjoy the sweet noble life!

items.contentHtml:
Guys I'm telling you ts is peak yo. We got the Korean shadow garden rocking up the neighborhood (iykyk). Unfortunately for this neighbourhood the garden consists of people capable of ending the world, I do not recommend pissing them off, or our glorious blue moon for that matter.

On a more serious note, It's one of those followers get infatuated with a seemingly op guy with giga brain level plays that shouldn't but do work out in his favour. If you're an enjoyer of aura farming, insane panels of pure tuff-ness, and the MC trying to just live his best life through the politics and cruelty of the world,
Then I highly recommend reading at least the first 10 chapters (the only ones in English at the moment of writing), you may find the MC a lot deeper man than you first find him.

Though if such a task is still too monumental to the you who reads this, I hope you enjoy the next gem you come across!
